name: SAES Getters S.p.A.
summary: SAES Getters S.p.A. is an Italian high-tech company specializing in advanced material science, developing and manufacturing getter and advanced materials-based solutions for industrial and medical applications. The company's products are used in a wide range of industries, including display, lighting, vacuum, and medical devices. SAES Getters is headquartered in Lainate, Italy.
